description: (new!) Brown Butter NYC Cookies Recipe 🍪🤤 Browning butter is a fairly easy level up that can take your bakes from good to amazing! It enhances the flavour, adding a lovely nutty depth to these NYC cookies, which are based on my classic NYC chocolate chip cookie recipe. If you’ve never tried brown butter cookies before, then please give these ones a go and let me know what you think - it is definitely worth the extra step! 😋 Full recipe, details & method on www.janespatisserie.com INGREDIENTS Browning the butter 175g unsalted butter Cookie dough 125g browned butter  175g light brown sugar 1 egg 1 tsp vanilla (optional!) 275g plain flour  1tbsp cornflour 1 + 1/2 tsp baking powder 1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda 1/2 tsp sea salt 300g chocolate  METHOD Brown the butter by melting in a pan and heating for a few minutes to a lovely nutty burnt texture Let this cool fully and set Cookie dough Mix the browned butter with the sugar Add the egg/vanilla and mix Add the flour, baking powder, bicarb and salt and mix  Add the chocolate  Portion into 8-9 balls and chill  Preheat the oven to 180c fan  Bake for 11-13 minutes Cool for 30 minutes  #JanesPatisserie #BrownButter #BrownButterCookies #NYCCookies #CookieRecipes
transcript: Homemade cookies are by far one of my favourite things in the world but by the time you add in some browned butter they level up even more and to be honest I didn't think this was possible. These brown butter New York style cookies are my new recipe on my blog now and they are utterly delicious. The process of browning butter really is quite simple where you let it melt into a pan, you sort of create a natural or burnt nutty flavour, you let this butter cool and then you can use it in your recipe. I used all light brown soft sugar in this because I wanted to add more of a natural caramel element as well as the nutty flavour from the butter. Add in all your usual suspects for this cookie dough, we're adding in corn flour for a soft delicious texture, sea salt, bicarb, baking powder and plain flour as well as your egg and vanilla before this. I wanted to make this a triple chocolate chunk cookie as well so I used bars of chocolate that I roughly chopped up but you can use chocolate buttons, chocolate chips, anything like that. Split your cookies into large cookie dough balls about 120 grams each, roll these up and then chill them in the fridge for about an hour or the freezer for half an hour. Once they have chilled split them between your trays and bake in your preheated oven. They'll be gloriously gooey and delicious but I like to add a little extra sprinkler sea salt as well.
